question: A and B started their journeys from X to Y and Y to X, respectively. After crossing each other, A and B completed remaining parts of their journeys in 6{1 {} over 8} hours and 8 hours, respectively. If the speed of A is 32 km/h, then the speed, in km/h of B is:
solution:
**Given:**

Time is taken by A after crossing (T₁) = 6(1)/(8) hours = 49/8 hours

Time is taken by B after crossing (T₂) = 8 hours

The speed of A = 32 km/h
